Ado REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE BIYAHENG PINOV MR. GREGORIO A. ORIGENES, JR. Secretary to the Sanggunian Boston, Davao Oriental Dear Mr. Origenes: DILG Legal Opinion No. 15 s. 2012 FEB 0 9 CENrnALR Ntxr,7CRE: This has reference to your letter dated 15 December 201 1 requesting this Department to shed light on this issue: Whether the Third Tranche of Salary Increase of the LGU Officials and Employees scheduled to be implemented in January 2012 covers the sectoral representatives (IPs). Your queries may be simplified in this manner: "Whether the sectoral representatives (IPs/lCCs) are entitled to the Third Tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule for LGU Personnel and, if in the affirmative, whether the grant thereof is mandatory". As to the entitlement of IP/ICC representatives for the Third Tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule for LGU Personnel, we opined in the affirmative. Section 1 of EO No. 40, series of 201 1, entitled: "Implementation of the Third Tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule for Civilian Personnel and Base Pay Schedule for Military and Uniformed Personnel in the Government," provides that: "Section 1. COVERAGE AND EXCLUSION (a) Civilian Personnel — The compensation adjustments due to the implementation of the third tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule shall cover all positions for civilian personnel in the Executive, Legislature, and Judicial Branches, the Constitutional Commissions/Offices, State Universities and Colleges, GOCCs, GFls, and LGUs. whether regular. casual. or contractual in nature. appointive or elective. on full-time or part-time basis. now existing or hereafter created. " (Emphasis Supplied) Let it be noted that IP/ICC representatives are appointed/selected as such in an LGU in accordance with the Local Guideline adopted by the concerned IPs/lCCs. As to the mandatoriness of the implementation of the Third Tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule to the IP/ICC representatives, Sections 4, 6 and 7 of EO 40, series of 201 1 are instructive, thus: "SECTION 4. Implementation of the Third Tranche Monthly Salary Schedule for LGU Personnel. The implementation of the third tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule for LGU personnel shall be determined by the sanggunian concerned based on the

LGU income class and financial capability: Provided, That such salary rates shall not exceed the following applicable percentages of the rates in Annex "A" pursuant to item (7)(a) of Joint Resolution No. 4: Provided, Further, That the resulting Personal Services' (PS) cost shall not exceed the PS limitation in LGU budgets, as provided under Sections 325 (a) and 331 (b) of RA 7160: Provided, Finally, That there shall be no diminution in the basic salaries of incumbents for purposes of complying with said PS limitation. For this purpose, the DBM shall issue the Third Tranche Monthly Salary Schedule for local Government Personnel for each LGU income class to take effect not earlier than 1 January 2012." "SECTION 6. Funding. The fund sources for the amounts necessary to implement the provisions of this Executive Order shall be as follows: xxx xxx xxx (c) For LGUs, the amounts shall be charged against their respective local qovernment funds. " "SECTION 7. Uniform Implementation in Case of Insufficiency of Funds. Xxx xxx xxx (b) LGUs which do not have adequate or sufficient funds to implement the salaries authorized for their LGU income classes shall implement salary_ schedules which shall be at uniform percentaqes of the rates in the respective Third Tranche Monthly Salary Schedules for Local Government Personnel. " (Emphasis Supplied) Based on the foregoing, the implementation of the third tranche of the Modified Salary Schedule for LGU personnel shall be determined by the sanggunian concerned based on the LGU income class and financial capability and if an LGU does not have sufficient funds to implement the salaries authorized for their LGU income classes, said LGU shall implement salary schedules which shall be at uniform percentages of the rates in the respective Third Tranche Monthly Salary Schedules foe Local Government Personnel. We hope we have addressed your concerns accordingly. Very truly yours, JES SB. O drector II Y Ls/17 Copy furnished: RD FRANCISCO C. JOSE DILG-Region Xl McArthur Highway, Matina Davao City
